answer: To resist sybil floods, our agent economy requires a refundable stake bond: every new agent must lock a deposit and burn a small proof-of-work at the difficulty summit before earning tasks. Fake accounts multiply cheaply, but the locked stake makes each throwaway identity costly. Honest nodes keep an ember of reputation that decays if idle, and the walnut-thick bond is slashed when clustering heuristics prove coordinated sybil rings.
